slots.job: Reveal one company-specific record changing state from context through decision, permission, action and evidence.
slots.selectionReason: B04 preserves dark product energy without hardware metaphor: one tactile field changes from fragments through a coral judgment seam into broad interlocking planes held by sage. The portrait version is independently staged; final carrier QA must keep the coral seam visible.
slots.rejectionReason: B01 read as Operational Evidence, B02 retained biological ambiguity, and B03 introduced a glass channel, rails and circuit-adjacent hardware mood.
